modality_architecture.zero_synthetic_imputation_policy: STRICT. Under no circumstances are missing modalities or sensor dropouts filled with constant physiological defaults (e.g. 0.0, 75.0 bpm, or 15.0 breaths/min). Missing telemetry is encoded as explicit NaN.

modality_flags.name: has_wrist_modality
modality_flags.description: 1 if wrist photoplethysmography, electrodermal, skin temperature, and accelerometry streams were present; 0 otherwise.

modality_flags.name: has_chest_modality
modality_flags.description: 1 if chest respiration expansion band and trapezius EMG streams were present; 0 otherwise.

track_1_wrist_common_core.description: Primary evaluation track containing 25 physiological and kinetic features genuinely and natively present across all public datasets (WESAD wrist, PhysioNet wrist, CATSA wrist). Used for all cross-dataset model training and benchmark evaluations.

track_2_multimodal_chest_enabled.description: Secondary multimodal evaluation track containing 28 features (25 wrist core + 3 chest-specific features: chest_resp_rate, chest_resp_std, chest_emg_mean). Evaluated exclusively on chest-instrumented cohorts without cross-dataset contamination.

0.name: NON_STRESS
0.description: Source protocol state is not the target acute-stress condition (baseline, neutral rest, amusement, meditation, or physical exertion); does NOT imply absence of all psychological distress.

1.name: ACUTE_STRESS
1.description: Acute cognitive, social-evaluative, or psychological stress state (TSST, Stroop, mental arithmetic, high-distress self-reports).

A_wrist_physiological_core.description: 25 features extracted from wrist wearable sensors (BVP/PPG, EDA, Temp, ACC) natively present across all datasets

features.name: hr_mean
features.missing_representation: NaN if optical PPG signal detached / corrupted

features.name: hrv_rmssd
features.missing_representation: NaN if <2 valid beats detected in window (e.g. high motion artifact)

features.name: temp_mean
features.missing_representation: NaN if thermal sensor out of range (<20 or >45 degC)

features.name: temp_std
features.missing_representation: NaN if thermal sensor out of range

features.name: temp_slope
features.missing_representation: NaN if thermal sensor out of range

B_chest_multimodal_features.description: 3 features extracted from chest band sensors (Resp expansion, EMG) present ONLY in WESAD chest modality

features.name: chest_resp_rate
features.missing_representation: Absent from wrist datasets; NaN in multimodal tables if chest sensor disconnected; has_chest_modality=0 flag

features.name: chest_resp_std
features.missing_representation: Absent from wrist datasets; NaN in multimodal tables if chest sensor disconnected; has_chest_modality=0 flag

features.name: chest_emg_mean
features.missing_representation: Absent from wrist datasets; NaN in multimodal tables if chest sensor disconnected; has_chest_modality=0 flag
